author: bug_d3v
text:
Censys counts 74.2 million web properties running an NGINX version hit by this week's RCE bugs.

The worst one, CVE-2026-123007: an integer overflow in HTTP/2 flow control.
Only precondition: HTTP/2 on a listener.
Vulnerable since 1.9.5. That's 2015.

Fixed in 1.31.9 and 1.30.7. https://t.co/k0yXMMawHo

Google's threat team found "exploit_agent": an LLM pipeline that diffs code before and after a patch, finds the fixed bug, writes an exploit and runs it. No human involved.

The gap between "patch released" and "patch applied" is now the attack window.
